key_insight: The paper introduces a fully automated way to build ontology-grounded multiple-choice benchmarks where correct answers are entailed by design and distractors are reasoner-verified as wrong.
engineering_relevance: This provides a practical, scalable testbed for measuring and diagnosing logical reasoning in LLMs used for scientific AI, including materials and biomedical knowledge tasks.
method: Generate MCQs from sufficiently axiomatised OWL 2 ontologies.
Create distractors by perturbing the right-hand side of class-definition axioms.
Use OWL reasoner entailment checks to verify distractors are formally incorrect.
evidence_signal: The pipeline produced 112, 2,491, and 15,216 MCQs on Pizza, PMDco, and DOID, with zero-shot LLM accuracy ranging from 41.1% to 76.8% versus a 25% random baseline.
watch_item: Benchmark quality depends on the completeness and axiomatization of the source ontology, so sparse or inconsistent ontologies may limit coverage or validity.
paper_title: Ontology-Grounded, Reasoner-Verified Benchmarks for Evaluating LLM Reasoning in Scientific AI
